decisions.reason: Certified gasketed plate exchangers for HVAC fit the core portfolio and cost little to keep, and after one year their prospects are still too uncertain to justify abandoning the option.
The box cooler already shows a positive signal of high quality and major market share in water cooling, so the option is in the money and worth further commitment.
The marine cooling unit has its own page, complements the box cooler in the marine segment, and keeping it costs little while uncertainty is still resolving.
The compact oil cooler is only mentioned and has no results yet, but it is a low-cost addition to a broad portfolio and remains a cheap option to hold.
Finned tubes are a component technology with its own page that feeds the air cooler business, so keeping the option open is cheap and strategically useful.
Enhanced exchanger tubes reflect R&D-based efficiency gains across multiple exchanger types, and with uncertain but potentially broad value the option should be kept open.
